title: execute or deny controlled rollback drill after canary activation evidence

files.role: controlled rollback drill gate evaluation and denial projection script
controlled rollback handoff for support/recovery binding

criteria: The projection script consumes RC10-022 activation denial and handoff before evaluating rollback drill gates.
The rollback PlanSpec requirement is projected but non-executable because activation was not performed and rollback approval/security gates are absent.
The rollback gate report records rollback-denied with rollback_execution_allowed=false and rollback_execution_performed=false.

The rollback denial evidence covers publication, drift-zero, quarantine fetch, target enrollment, activation denial, rollback approval, AgentCore rollback PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine rollback, remote dispatch, and rollback authorization blockers.
The controlled rollback handoff moves the workflow to RC10-031 while support upload and recovery execution remain disabled.
